checks.rationale: AC1 is incomplete: a single effect accepts terminal-to-running regression and different successive successful outputs; corrupted saved quiescence can manufacture a confirmed stopped result. AC2 dispatch capability, configured-model/rank/effort, and observed-model fences pass the examined cases, but restored derived facts are not fully validated.

The implementation remains an offline injected fake using actual TASK-003 DTOs and TASK-038 settings. It does not introduce production calls, canonical workflow persistence, multi-host coordination, TASK-020 review gate logic, TASK-021 leases, or undeclared v1 effort fields. The two observable defects are recorded under AC1 and do not require scope expansion.

start binds the entire immutable request and stable effect identity; independent probes reject 22 changed request fields and 18 changed poll/cancel handle cases. However, poll advances solely by script position and ignores the recorded terminal observation/quiescence, while cancel can report already_terminal after poll has returned running. R1-TASK-017-001 is reproduced through public methods.

Injected atomic-replace failures correctly roll back start, script, poll and cancellation mutations, preserve prior file bytes and remove temporary files. Invalid observed identity/provenance is rejected without consuming scripts. Restoration nevertheless accepts inconsistent saved quiescence and cursor/last-observation facts, making the recovery error path unsafe (R1-TASK-017-002).

Unknown-to-reconciled polling, non-quiescent default cancellation, immutable scripts, wrong request/lease/model identities and exact retries are covered. Four independent fresh processes recover one effect through unknown/pending to stable success/already_terminal. Temporal terminal regression and internally inconsistent saved-state edges remain accepted, as reproduced in both findings.

The declared command was independently rerun from the exact worktree on Windows Python 3.12.14: 20 tests, exit 0. Candidate-bound Windows/Linux Python 3.11.16 evidence hashes match. Tests meaningfully exercise success, failures and separate-process recovery, but terminal consistency and saved-state validation cases needed to detect the reproduced defects are absent; the malformed-state test only checks an invalid top-level format.

All three added paths are task-owned. The optional private JSON simulation store supports the explicitly dispatched sequential recovery requirement and stays distinct from TASK-009/010 canonical state. Public Protocol signatures, schemas, shared configuration and downstream service ownership are unchanged.

Native Git confirms base 759819dedf2dda010530e124c284f0c63f261d15 is the candidate merge-base, head d8930f07ca90cd0dc95ccd452a38d8fcfde8e0c4 is clean, and exactly agents.py, its test leaf and its handoff are added. Raw diff, 14 committed context hashes, three ROOT validation hashes, policy/model digest and canonical fingerprint all match. Approved r4 structural digest recomputes over all 39 tasks; TASK-003/004/038 are accepted dependencies.

The explicit agents submodule implements the frozen start/poll/cancel signatures using accepted immutable values. Capabilities and configuration are injected, scripted input iterables detach to tuples, the private persistence format has a simulation/version marker, and lock/rollback responsibilities are localized. The defects can be repaired within the existing owner without a public interface or dependency change.

No credentials, network/provider calls or authority promotion were found; configured:false stays non-dispatchable, simulation labels distinguish submitted effort from unavailable observed effort, and five observed model identity mutations are rejected repeatedly. The local saved-state boundary can still manufacture confirmed quiescence, and terminal facts can conflict with later live observations, undermining safe downstream resource-release decisions.

The handoff accurately describes the owned interface, sequential one-owner backing-file boundary, configured-vs-simulated provenance, actual test command and downstream ownership. Its claim that unknown-field and internally inconsistent saved state fail is contradicted by accepted nested scope fields, cursor-without-observation and unobserved quiescence reproductions. Repair behavior and add matching evidence before retaining that claim.

findings.description: src/agents.py:957-1015 advances poll/cancel scripts without enforcing already-observed terminal facts. A public script [succeeded(output-first), running] returns succeeded then running; cancel then reports already_terminal with quiesced=true. [succeeded(output-first), succeeded(output-second)] returns two different committed results for the same effect. A confirmed cancelled result can also be followed by default queued polling. This allows downstream consumers to see live or replaced results after the same effect was declared safe to release.
findings.expected_fix: Enforce consistent terminal facts across poll and cancellation observations inside the existing fake adapter/provider state. After an observed terminal result, preserve its structured result or reject conflicting subsequent script observations without consuming them; confirmed quiescence must not be followed by a live queued/running observation for that effect. Add regressions for terminal-to-live transitions, different successive successful outputs, cancellation/poll order and recovery of the terminal invariant.

findings.description: src/agents.py:710-768 validates primitive saved-field types and cursor ranges but trusts quiesced, last_observation and cursor relationships. Starting an effect with no observations, changing only saved quiesced=false to true, and reopening the provider succeeds; idempotent start followed by cancel returns already_terminal/quiesced=true with newly generated simulation evidence despite no observed stop. A poll_position of 1 with last_observation=null also restores and skips the first result. Nested unknown request.scope fields are silently discarded at lines 293-337, contrary to the documented strict saved-state boundary.
findings.expected_fix: Validate restored derived state against the immutable effect, consumed script prefixes and recorded last/terminal observations; reject impossible cursors, unsupported quiescence and conflicting identities/provenance with validation_failed before returning a usable provider. Enforce exact nested object fields for the private format. Preserve legitimate zero-script/default queued observations and sequential recovery, and add targeted corrupted-state tests including the reproduced cases. No canonical journal or multi-owner store is required.
